title: ota-build patch-report.json
description: <patch out dir>/patch-report.json written by `ota-build patch` (packages/ota-build/src/patch.ts, interface PatchReport) next to the *.hdiff patch files, after a mandatory round trip through the shipped C++ apply. Consumed by `ota-build deploy-args`, which turns two reports (android + ios) into `ota-cli deploy` flags. NOT expressible: hostChanged/changedUnits/items consistency (hostChanged iff an item has unit "host"; changedUnits = the other item units), referenced patch files exist.

appVersion.description: Binary release line shared by base and new build; null when unknown.

base.description: sha256 of the BASE build's build.json.

new.description: sha256 of the NEW build's build.json.

deltaMode.description: True if the NEW build was compiled with `hermesc -base-bytecode` against the embedded base (build.json delta.enabled); production can monitor the benefit via items[].deltaOverPlain.

hostChanged.description: True if the host bundle differs.

changedUnits.description: Names of units (not host) whose bundle differs.

idsChanged.description: True if ids.json differs between base and new build.

items.description: One item per changed file (host first, then units by name).

patchFile.description: Patch file name (*.hdiff) in the same directory as the report.

patchSize.description: Size of the chosen patch file in bytes.

updateType.description: `patch` (delta) or `full` (diff against an empty file, chosen when the delta exceeds fullThreshold x zstd size of the new file).

builtHash.description: sha256 of the new bundle: what the device must obtain after applying (Entry.hash).

baseHash.description: sha256 of the base bundle the patch applies to.

deltaPatchSize.description: Size of the delta patch even when `full` was chosen (information).

newZstdSize.description: zstd size of the new bundle in bytes.

plainEquivalentSize.description: Only with `patch --report-plain`: size of the delta patch the same JS would have produced compiled WITHOUT -base-bytecode (equals deltaPatchSize for a non-delta build).

deltaOverPlain.description: Only with `patch --report-plain`: deltaPatchSize / plainEquivalentSize, 4 decimals (below 1 means the delta compile helped).

toolchain.description: Toolchain of the new build (identical to the base's, enforced).

algo.description: Patch algorithm parameters (PATCH_ALGO in patch.ts); changing any needs a new patchAlgoVer.

fullThreshold.description: Emit `full` when patchSize > fullThreshold x zstd size of the new file.

tools.description: Hashes of the native tools that produced and verified the patches.

ota_apply.description: sha256 of the ota_apply binary used for the round trip.
